items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I had a white rug on the floor and we'd sit on the floor and each one would take turns playing... Wardell Gray

ctx.x: Cafe Society uptown. He had both Cafe Society uptown, Barney Josephson did, and Cafe Society downtown. So I began hanging out on 52nd Street with the cats and they knew that I always helped musicians and so they'd - we'd come uptown around 4 o'clock or 4:30 in the morning and stay up all day, playing. There was Tadd Dameron, Bud Powell, Erroll Garner, Mel (Torme D'Armaine), and Miles Davis. Let's see, another trumpet player - Fats Navarro. A tenor man that was with Benny Goodman when he came out East - Wardell…
Oh, you played at your place, you mean?
